notes: kb/Work PB1083: the ALL list is ONE membership, DataBinder.IsRepositoryIntrinsic, asked by the declaration screen, IntrinsicBinder.KeywordOmittedFunction (and its reserved-name arm) and ReferenceResolver.IsFunctionBearing — it used to be IntrinsicCatalog.TryGet(written word) three times over.
